key_insight: P3D-Bench introduces a benchmark for evaluating whether multimodal LLMs can generate parametric 3D models from text or images using code, not just outputs that look correct. It tests deeper capabilities like geometric precision, semantic alignment, and assembly consistency.
problem_solved: Existing benchmarks rarely assess 3D modeling through code generation, even though real parametric 3D creation requires more than runnable programs. This paper addresses the gap by measuring how well MLLMs can produce structured, accurate 3D programs from multimodal specifications.
method: Build a benchmark focused on parametric 3D generation via code-based modeling tasks.
Evaluate models on multiple dimensions: geometric correctness, semantic fidelity, and assembly consistency.
Use text and visual prompts to test whether models can translate specifications into valid 3D programs.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this provides a more realistic way to measure MLLMs for design and 3D generation tasks. It helps identify models that can reason about structure and object composition, not just generate plausible-looking code.

paper_title: P3D-Bench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Parametric 3D Generation and Structural Reasoning
paper_authors: Yikang Yang, Zhanpeng Hu, Youtian Lin, Mengqi Zhou, Jingxi Xu
